en.summary: Most nosebleeds are from minor irritation. Pinch soft part of nose 10 minutes, lean forward. Emergency if bleeding >20 minutes, after head injury, possible broken nose, or on blood thinners with ongoing bleed. Educational MedlinePlus framing.
emergencyIf: Bleeding does not stop after 20 minutes
seeDoctorIf: Nosebleeds not linked to cold/minor irritation
selfCare: Sit, pinch soft nose 10 full minutes, lean forward, breathe through mouth
Cold compress across bridge; avoid packing gauze inside
Avoid sniffing/blowing for several hours after
doNot: Do not pack gauze deep into the nose as first step

fr.summary: La plupart des épistaxis sont bénignes. Pincer 10 minutes, pencher en avant. Urgence si > 20 min, après traumatisme crânien, nez cassé, ou anticoagulants.

he.summary: רוב דימומי האף קלים. ללחוץ 10 דקות ולהתכופף קדימה. חירום אם מעל 20 דקות, אחרי חבלת ראש, או תחת מדללי דם.
emergencyIf: מדללי דם עם דימום קשה לעצירה

ru.summary: Большинство носовых кровотечений неопасны. Зажмите мягкую часть носа на 10 минут, наклонитесь вперёд. Неотложка если >20 минут, после травмы головы, перелом носа или антикоагулянты.
